description: Return a picture of the REMOTE computer's screen from the open session, exactly as the viewer is drawing it. Use this to see what is on the computer you are connected to; jrd_screenshot captures this computer instead. Needs an open session where this computer is the viewer (jrd_connect) with the session view showing in the AttachDesk window. The reply states the picture size and the remote size. To click a spot you see, pass its x and y with from_screenshot: true to jrd_mouse_click, jrd_mouse_move, jrd_mouse_scroll or jrd_mouse_drag. Fails with a clear message when no session is open or the first picture has not arrived yet.

format.description: jpeg (default) is much smaller. Use png when small text must stay sharp.

max_width.description: Reduce the picture to at most this many pixels wide. Default 1280, which most models read without resizing it again. Pass 0 for the full remote size.

quality.description: JPEG quality 1 to 100 (ignored for png). Default 80.

name: jrd_remote_screenshot
